description: This file is an implementation of a service that reads and retrieves loan account data within the Fineract project. It provides methods to retrieve individual loan details, lists of loans with filtering, templates for loan creation, transaction templates, and other loan-related data operations. The class interacts extensively with the database via JDBC and maps SQL result sets to domain data objects. It also handles security context for authorization.

classes.name: LoanCurrencyDataMapper
classes.description: A RowMapper implementation that maps SQL ResultSet rows to CurrencyData objects for loan currency information.

classes.name: LoanMapper
classes.description: A RowMapper implementation that maps SQL ResultSet rows to LoanAccountData objects, providing comprehensive loan details including customer, product, and status information.

classes.name: LoanDisbursementDetailMapper
classes.description: A private class that maps SQL query results for loan disbursement details to DisbursementData objects.

classes.name: CurrencyMapper
classes.description: A RowMapper that converts ResultSet rows into CurrencyData objects, mapping currency code, name, symbol, and other details.

classes.name: RepaymentTransactionTemplateMapper
classes.description: A class that constructs SQL schema for fetching repayment transaction templates and maps result set rows to LoanTransactionData objects for repayment templates.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single loan account data by loan ID, executing a SQL query to fetch and map data from the database.

methods.name: retrieveLoanByLoanAccount
methods.description: Fetches loan account data based on a specific loan account number.

methods.name: fetchRepaymentScheduleData
methods.description: Generates and attaches the repayment schedule data to the provided loan account data.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentSchedule
methods.description: Retrieves the repayment schedule for a specific loan ID, constructing schedule data by executing a parametrized SQL query.

methods.name: retrieveLoanTransactions
methods.description: Fetches all relevant transactions for a specified loan ID, including transaction relations and charges paid.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of loans based on search parameters, applying filters and sorting.

methods.name: retrieveTemplateWithClientAndProductDetails
methods.description: Creates a loan template pre-filled with client and product data, useful for loan application forms.

methods.name: retrieveTemplateWithGroupAndProductDetails
methods.description: Creates a loan template pre-filled with group and product data, suitable for group loan applications.

methods.name: retrieveTemplateWithCompleteGroupAndProductDetails
methods.description: Creates a detailed loan template with full group and client data, including group memberships and hierarchy.

methods.name: retrieveLoanTransactionTemplate
methods.description: Provides a transaction template for a given loan and transaction type, ready for user input.

methods.name: retrieveLoanPrePaymentTemplate
methods.description: Prepares a template for prepayment transactions, including details on outstanding amounts.

methods.name: retrieveWaiveInterestDetails
methods.description: Fetches details necessary to process an interest waiver transaction for a loan.

methods.name: retrieveNewClosureDetails
methods.description: Provides details for writing off or closing a loan account.

methods.name: retrieveApprovalTemplate
methods.description: Generates the approval template for a loan, including available disbursement amounts.

methods.name: retrieveDisbursalTemplate
methods.description: Prepares a disbursal transaction template, optionally including payment options.

methods.name: retrieveNumberOfRepayments
methods.description: Returns the count of scheduled repayment installments for a loan.

methods.name: getRepaymentDataResponse
methods.description: Produces a list of repayment schedule installment data objects.

methods.name: retrieveLoanTransaction
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific loan transaction by transaction ID.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductDetailsTemplate
methods.description: Creates a template with detailed loan product, option types, and related data for a specified product, client or group ID.

methods.name: retrieveCalendars
methods.description: Retrieves calendars associated with the specified group, including recurring date adjustments.

methods.name: retrieveAllowedLoanOfficers
methods.description: Returns a list of staff eligible for loans in the specified office, optionally restricted to staff in that office only.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoansWithOverdueInstallments
methods.description: Returns all loans with overdue installments that meet certain penalty and interest conditions.

methods.name: retrieveAllOverdueInstallmentsForLoan
methods.description: Fetches overdue overdue installments for a specific loan, considering penalties and interest recalculations.

methods.name: retriveLoanCounter
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum loan product counter for a group or client, used for loan numbering.

methods.name: retrieveLoanDisbursementDetails
methods.description: Returns disbursement details for a given loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveLoanDisbursementDetails (list version)
methods.description: Returns disbursement details for a list of loan IDs, grouped by loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveLoanDisbursementDetail
methods.description: Fetches disbursement detail for a specific loan and disbursement ID.

methods.name: retrieveRecoveryPaymentTemplate
methods.description: Creates a template for recovery payments, initializing transaction data with current loan info.

methods.name: retrieveLoanWriteoffTemplate
methods.description: Prepares a transaction template for writing off a loan, including outstanding totals.

methods.name: retrieveLoanChargeOffTemplate
methods.description: Prepares a template for charging off a loan, including various outstanding components.

methods.name: fetchLoansForInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Fetches loans that need interest recalculation based on several interest, rate, and schedule conditions.

methods.name: fetchLoansForInterestRecalculation (paged version)
methods.description: Fetches a paged list of loans due for interest recalculation, optionally filtered by office hierarchy and max ID.

methods.name: isGuaranteeRequired
methods.description: Checks whether a guarantee funds hold is required for the specified loan.

methods.name: retrieveMinimumDateOfRepaymentTransaction
methods.description: Gets the earliest repayment transaction date for a loan.

methods.name: retrieveTotalPaidInAdvance
methods.description: Calculates total amount paid in advance for a loan, considering schedule and derived amounts.

methods.name: retrieveRefundByCashTemplate
methods.description: Creates a refund transaction template for a loan disbursed via cash.

methods.name: retrieveCreditBalanceRefundTemplate
methods.description: Creates a refund template for credit balance refunds on a loan.

methods.name: retrieveRefundTemplate
methods.description: A helper method to build refund transaction data objects.

methods.name: retrieveLoanInterestRatePeriodData
methods.description: Returns interest rate periods applicable to a loan, especially floating-rate linked loans, updating effective rates.

methods.name: updateInterestRatePeriodData
methods.description: Helper to calculate effective interest rates for interest rate periods based on differential and base rates.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdsWithPendingIncomePostingTransactions
methods.description: Fetches loan IDs with income posting transactions pending, based on specific criteria.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdsWithPendingIncomePostingTransactions (paged)
methods.description: Fetches a paged list of loans with pending income posting transactions, filtering by office hierarchy and max ID.

methods.name: getResolvedLoanId
methods.description: Resolves and returns the internal loan ID given an external ID, throwing if not found.

methods.name: getResolvedLoanTransactionId
methods.description: Resolves and returns the internal transaction ID, from either provided ID or external ID, throwing if not found.

methods.name: deriveDefaultInterestWaiverTransaction
methods.description: Builds a default interest waiver transaction, prioritizing overdue interest installments.
